config.title: The Cartographer's Study
config.prompt: Interior of an old cartographer's study, wide eye-level view from the doorway. Floor-to-ceiling walnut bookshelves line the left and right walls, a heavy oak desk covered in rolled maps and brass instruments stands in the middle of the room on a worn persian rug, a large antique globe on a stand to the right of the desk, a stone fireplace with glowing embers on the back wall, herringbone wood floor, warm lamp light with soft late-afternoon haze, richly detailed, photorealistic, no people

edit.prompt: Replace the oak desk in the middle of the room with a glowing holographic star-map table: a low round black glass plinth standing on the persian rug, projecting a translucent blue 3D constellation of stars and orbit lines above it. Remove the maps, lamp and brass instruments that were on the desk.
